title: Slushie Bar Xtra Crimson Berries 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Xtra Crimson Berries offers a rich and luscious mix of ripe red Berries, delivering a perfectly balanced blend of sweetness with just a hint of tartness. With every puff, the vibrant flavour of freshly picked Berries bursts through, offering a satisfying and full-bodied vape experience. Perfect for vapers who love bold fruit flavours, Crimson Berries provides a smooth and indulgent flavour sensation that can be enjoyed all day long. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Slushie Bar Xtra Nic Salts are designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. Each e-liquid in the collection provides smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for those seeking a satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids are perfect for all-day vaping with a flavour-packed experience waiting in every puff.
